text.tspan: Ministry Of Health, Social, Welfare & Gender Affairs
This is not a Certificate of Birth and is not proof of registration. It only confirms that
{{$defaultTo ($lookup $metadata 'createdAtLocation.name') '-'}} submitted birth information to the Civil Registry Office / Office of the Island Registrar.
The birth notification has been submitted. Registration has not yet been confirmed.
To complete the birth registration, please visit the Civil Registry Office or Office of the Island Registrar and bring this
receipt together with your identification. Registration staff will advise if any additional information or supporting
documents are required based on the parent details, marital status, or qualified informant. Once the birth has been
registered, an official Birth Certificate may be obtained from the Civil Registry Office.
This receipt is provided to support birth registration under the Civil Registration Act 2025. It is not a Certificate of Birth and is not proof that the
birth has been registered. An official Certificate of Birth may only be issued by the Registrar General, Civil Registry Office for Tuvalu.
